title: This Week In Running: April 13, 2026 — iRunFar
claims: The 2026 Two Oceans men's top five were Arthur Jantjies 3:09:25, Onalenna Khonkhobe 3:10:00, Blessing Waison 3:11:13, Dennis Kipkosgei 3:11:29 and Tumelo Moja 3:12:07.
The 2026 Two Oceans women's top five were Gerda Steyn 3:27:43, Margaret Jepchumba 3:33:31, Nobuhle Nobukhosi Tshuma 3:38:34, Shelmith Muriuki 3:39:14 and Rholex Jelimo 3:40:38.
Steyn won her seventh Two Oceans title in 3:27:43, almost six minutes ahead of second and just outside her own 3:26:54 course record from 2024.
iRunFar describes the 56 km course as backloaded, with the second-half climbs over Chapman's Peak Drive and Constantia Nek totaling about 700 m of elevation gain.
iRunFar reports a 2026 prize purse of USD 158,300 (ZAR 2.6 million), with ZAR 380,000 paid to each winner.

verification.note: iRunFar's 13 April 2026 weekly results column was read directly. It lists the top five men and women, Steyn's seventh title and 3:26:54 course record, the backloaded course and the 2026 prize purse. It is a specialist running publication, not the race organiser.
